title: Aperture: Auditable synthetic data for enterprise AI
summary: Aperture is a synthetic data validation and generation platform for enterprise AI teams, producing synthetic datasets alongside a Trust Report on fidelity, utility, privacy, and compliance. Its experimental benchmarking scripts directly import and run SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer as candidate generators compared against SMOTE and a real-data baseline.
